lines.en: I arrive at the bar with Sana to find the place already decked out in...well, not decorations, but whatever weird light bulbs Sara normally uses to make the color in here all pink and whatnot.
Apart from the lights, however, it doesn’t really appear that things have gotten underway as of yet.
I mean, there are no guests around- not even Maki and Haruka. And given that this place has been doing a little better than normal lately, that’s kind of disappointing.
I’m not really sure why I’m thinking so much about it, though, when I clearly have more important things to be doing.
Like helping Sana get dressed.
: Do you require assistance?
: ...I’m sorry?
: Picking out clothes.
: Or putting them on, I guess.
: No.
: No, I think I’m okay...
Fuck Halloween.
: Everything I’m supposed to bring to the party is...pretty light...so you can just stay down here and wait for me to get back...
: Are you sure you don’t need me to come up there and help with anything?
: Uh...well...
: I kind of...yelled at you the last time we were up there together, so...
: I think it’s probably best if you just stay down here...
: Yes. I can see how having me closer to your mother is better at quelling your uncertainty about our relationship than having me in her room with you.
: Well...it sounds weird when you put it like that...
: Because it is weird. But if that’s what you want, it’s fine by me.
: Could be good to catch up with her anyway.
: Just...don’t catch up too much...hahah...
: Hah...
Well...that’s that, I guess.
: Well, if it isn’t my favorite customer!
: Hey, Sara. You’re looking mostly sober tonight.
: You too, Yuki.
: Hey! How come your voice sounded a lot more gentle when you said that to her?
: Probably because Yuki’s sobriety is something we should be praising and yours is something we should be encouraging.
: Thanks, man. Sara’s not that far gone yet, though. ‘Least not from what I’ve seen.
: I’ll have you know I’ve been doing much better lately when it comes to not drinking while the bar is open.
: I wait until the doors are closed now.
: Well, that’s a step in the right direction, I guess.
: So, are you going to stay for the Halloween party again this year? Maki and Haruka are on their way over now.
: And, if the rumors I’ve heard are true, their costumes are even more...risque this year.
: Speaking of which, where’s yours? You seem like the type to pretty much always dress up for stuff like this.
: Not tonight.
: Well...at least not until I know how business is going to be.
: I’m sure we won’t be like, actually busy or anything, but I still have Yuki and your friend from the last party coming to temp for the night while Sana is out being a [teenager].
: Basically, I am prepared to work if I have to. And since my feminine wiles don’t work as well on our female clientele, I don’t have to get dressed up. I just want to.
: Besides, Yuki’s popular enough with the girls to make it so I barely even have to do anything.
: Yuki is? Really?
: Yo. The fuck is that supposed to mean?
: Hey, don’t ask me. You’re the one always calling yourself “not cute” or whatever.
: Not my fault that a bunch of girls are just settlin’ for the closest thing to a dude they can get with all the real ones up in space or whatever the fuck is goin’ on.
: I’d be willing to bet cash that any girl with short hair’s gettin’ the same fuckin’ treatment I am.
: Oh, stop. That uniform looks absolutely adorable on you. It’s no wonder so many girls are flocking to the place now.
: Yeah, sure the fuckin’ fliers you’ve been handin’ out to everyone and their mothers have nothin’ to do with it.
: Fliers mean nothing in the face of true beauty, Yuki.
: Guh.
: Good. Now, kiss.
: I suppose one wouldn’t hurt if that’s what you want to see, Sensei.
: The fuck, dude?! No! Not only is she a chick, she’s my boss now!
: ‘Sides, what if people fuckin’ walk in or whatever? Can’t say I’d wanna spend my money at some place where the employees are fucking behind the counters.
: I mean...I don’t think Sensei said anything about fucking...but I’d be lying if I said I wasn’t at least a little curious...
: Oh, you’ve gotta be fucking kidding me. You too?
: You’re just really popular now, Yuki. Embrace it.
: Hah...whatever. ‘Least I’m gettin’ paid.
: I’m still waiting on an answer to whether or not you’re staying, Sensei.
: I’m sure someone like you would be preeeetty popular around a bunch of sexually dissatisfied women.
: Assuming they show up, that is.
: As fond as I am of sexually dissatisfied women, I’m not sure if I’m able to hang around this time.
: Pretty sure the party for my class is basically underway already.
Not to mention I’d much prefer being in a room full of primarily virgins than one with a handful of women who have been around the block a few times.
Sue me.
: Are you really gonna say no to these cute little faces?
: We need you, Sensei~
: We need you to save our bar...and our bodies...
: I think I’m good, actually. Not in the best shape anymore, but don’t think I need saving yet.
: Really? Because I’d think that if anyone in this room needed saving, it would be you.
: Dude, there are three people in this room. And you two are making it pretty clear you fuck like rabbits already, so...
: Weeeeeell...I don’t know if rabbits is the right word...
: Uh-huh. Sure, boss.
: Now, can you let go of my chin? You’re startin’ to leave a mark.
: Oh...no.
: Sensei and I are just friends, actually.
: I just get a little flirty around him sometimes.
: Really? Well, sure had me fooled.
Sara goes silent for a moment before finally removing her finger from Yuki’s chin.
Before the conversation is able to pick back up, however, the “friend of mine” that Sara alluded to earlier finally decides to walk in...
: Hello, attractive bartender woman!
: I have returned to this building of female fornication for the purpose of pouring liquids into hollow glass cylinders and making people dizzy!
: Please pay me in feathers!
: Wha-
: Welcome back, Kaori.
: Ah! Friend! You are here as well!
: Do you intend to fornicate with the bar lady or her handsome friend with sadbags under her eyes?
: Please warn me beforehand if you do so I can look away and pretend to not hear anything!
Kaori makes her way over to the bar and Yuki looks incredibly dumbfounded for some-
Oh. Wait.
Yeah, this is probably really weird for her considering the last conversation I had about Kaori ended with me finding out she's related to Yumi.
And...if Kaori is related to Yumi, it’s probably safe to assume...yeah.
: Surprise.
: Is something wrong, Yuki?
: Bar lady, have you created a new policy in which customers order beverages from the opposite side of the large wooden rectangle?
: No, Kaori. Yuki is an employee here.
: I think it may be time to fire her, for she does not appear to be doing much of anything.
: Allow me to step in here and try to explain the situation just enough to not cause anyone’s brain to malfunction.
: Well, any more than it already malfunctions on a daily basis.
: Yuki actually knows Kaori.
: Is this about the instant gram again?! I already took those pictures down! This should have erased the memory of everyone who saw them!
: That’s not how memory or...any of that works, Kaori.
: What do you mean Yuki knows her? From where?
: Well...
: We’re related...
: You’re what?! Really?
: She’s my niece.
: I believe the word is pronounced “nice.” And thank you, tired-looking woman.
: Kaori, a niece is a sibling’s child. Like the red haired girl you’ve seen me with before.
: But, Friend! I have seen you with so many girls that it is impossible to keep track of them all!
: Besides, the hospital people told me everyone else was gone. I do not have what you humans would call a “family.”
: You really don’t remember me? I used to pick you up and take you to hang out with Yumi when she was still all little and shit.
: My memory became bad after the whapam, kaboom, shhhhhhhh. I don’t remember you at all.
: Wow. Small fuckin' world.
: I do not see what the size of the world has to do with our relation, but “Earth” is actually very large. Bigger than three whole cheese wheels.
: How long have you known about this?
: Not long. I just found out recently and...I guess it slipped my mind until right now?
: Umm...Mom?...
: Sana, dear. What in the world are you supposed to be?
: I don’t even know anymore...
: That is certainly an...interesting choice for a costume.
: I thought there would be less...revealing choices available...
: I mean...it wasn’t really weird to wear more revealing clothing back then, right?
: We grew up around the same time, didn’t we? Back me up on this.
: Fishnets and tight jeans I can understand. It’s the gas mask, weird gloves, and crop top with the word “Fire” on it that I’m confused by.
: I’m sure they...made sense at the time?
: And you’re not just into really weird shit?
: Will you like me more if I am?
: Mom! Stop!
: Sorry, sorry. I couldn’t help it, dear.
: You look adorable as...whatever you are.
: Did you find all the decorations you needed?
: Yeah, they’re near the door...Which means I’m ready to go whenever...
: We’re going to have to take the bus, too, so...we should probably start heading out as soon as possible.
: You guys should have just had the party here. That’s what we did for the dorm war and only a handful of you wound up getting intoxicated.
: I will...relay that information to Ayane for next year’s party...
: Be safe, okay? If you’re going to drink, make sure Sensei is around to carry you to bed.
: Sensei...please ignore her and just...come with me...
: Well, sorry I can’t stay, but...yeah.
: It’s fine. I have a feeling we’ll be pretty busy tonight anyway, so having you around would just be a distraction for me.
: We can have our own party some other time.
: Have fun and look after Sana for me.
: Mom...come on...
I follow Sana away from the bar and-
: Yo! Hold up a second.
: What’s up? Mad at me for not confirming Kaori’s return as a zombie?
: Nah. That’s...weird as fuck, but...I’ve got the whole night to talk to her about it.
: It’s just...
: Well, today’s Yumi’s birthday and shit.
: And I know it’s not really your place to get involved any more than you already have, but...
: You want me to say happy birthday for you?
: Uh...yeah...
: If it’s not a problem, I mean.
: And...
: If you could maybe give her this, too...
: It’s not much, but...I don’t really have a lot I can spend and-
: Sure thing.
: I’m not sure if she’ll accept it, but I’ll definitely give it to her if she shows up to the party tonight.
: Thanks, man. Remind me to buy you ramen sometime when the power’s not getting all fucked at Tojo's anymore.
: Did it happen again after the last time?
: Just once more that I’ve noticed since then, but Tsu-chan still wouldn’t let me go near her dad.
: Huh. Weird.
: Sensei? We...really need to go...
: Oh, shit. My bad. I was-
: The fuck are you supposed to be?
: Bad at Halloween...
: Excuse me!
: Ah! Customerburger!
: I like your butterfly!
: Did you know that the average lifespan for the red admiral butterfly is approximately ten months?!
: Kaori, what did I tell you about giving insect facts to the customers before taking their orders?
: Noooooo tell me more butterfly facts. I wanna know!
: Then...did you know there are over 24,000 species?! And that some of them can fly up to 12 miles per hour?!
: Ahh, yeah. That’s the stuff.
: Inject that lepidopterology right into my veins, baby.
: Uhh...she botherin’ you? Cause if you’ve got somethin’ you wanna order-
: Not at all! I’ll take three of whatever your favorite thing on the menu is.
: Aight. Three beers. Got it.
: Yuki, come on! Upsell! Profits! Business lingo!
: What? She asked for my favorite thing on the menu.
: You are very pretty, Miss. Are you really having such trouble fornicating that you had to come here?
: Woah. The flier said “Halloween Party,” but I didn’t realize that’s the sorta thing I was getting myself into.
: Do you hit on everyone with butterfly related trivia or am I just lucky?
: Hitting on! I know what that means now!
: Hahahah! I love this place already!
